thread:
anna: Heads-up — product wants a small-ish tweak to per-route saved queries UX. They want to be able to store a query + a telemetry sample rate and a routing hint together.

devon: Can you sketch the primary use cases? e.g., user pins query for model X with 10% sampling and route to 'low-cost' fallback?

anna: Exactly. Typical: save filter+model combo used for A/B evals, and keep telemetry sampling attached so metrics are comparable across rollouts.

marco: Two concerns: 1) saved queries becoming a vehicle for routing policy (yay/nah?), 2) how we represent sampling & quota implications in the console.

sarah: On #1 — UX should surface a clear separation: saved query = filter + view, and an optional "runtime settings" block (sampling, routing tier). Default off. :white_check_mark:

jia: API note: saved-query objects currently live in /api/v1/saved_queries and schema is minimal: { id, name, scope, filter }. We can add a new optional field `runtime_config` but we need to decide shape.

devon: propose `runtime_config: { sampling_pct: number, preferred_route: string, ephemeral: boolean }`

marco: ephemeral boolean? meaning apply only when launching adhoc compare vs persisted rollout? clarify.

devon: yep — ephemeral=true means console will not apply it automatically for routes; only when user explicitly launches from the saved query card.

anna: UX request: when someone opens a saved query that contains routing hints, show an inline badge "Routing hints attached" and a tooltip explaining effects on quota & cost.

sarah: Also need to show token/req cost estimate when you toggle sampling. Basic compute: estimated_tokens * sampling_pct -> expected billable events; we can surface rough cost delta.

jia: Implementation debate: Should runtime_config be enforced server-side (i.e., agent service honors preferred_route) or client-side only (console shapes request but backend ignores)? We need consistent behavior for Dedicated/Private.

marco: Backend must honor it for predictability. We'll add a per-tenant policy that allows saved queries to include runtime hints. Default: ignored unless org opt-in.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: new schema migration queued: add column `runtime_config_json` to saved_queries (non-null default '{}').

devon: API contract draft (please review):
```
GET /api/v1/saved_queries/:id
{
  "id": "123",
  "name": "prod: high-latency routes",
  "scope": "route:foo",
  "filter": "model:open-4x AND latency>200",
  "runtime_config": {
    "sampling_pct": 10,
    "preferred_route": "low_cost",
    "ephemeral": false
  }
}
```

jia: question: do we also store telemetry sample key name? e.g., `telemetry_seed` so evals compare across time even if sample rates change.

anna: Good idea. Add `sample_key` optional. UI should show when sample_key present.

sarah: Rollout UX: when a saved query is attached to a canary, we should clearly call out if that saved query changes telemetry sampling — risk of noisy regression alerts.

marco: +1. Add an audit hook: changes to runtime_config must generate an event in route activity stream and optionally create a flag for quality-monitoring to rebaseline.

devon: Implementation tasks: API schema change, DB migration, console badges + cost estimator, backend enforcement for routing hints, audit events, and e2e tests for Dedicated/Private.

anna: Prioritize: keep default behavior unchanged, require org opt-in for auto-applying preferred_route. Timeline: try to ship spec and PRs this week, migration in next sprint.

jia: I'll draft the OpenAPI patch and a migration script. Putting a WIP PR into eng-platform.

sarah: I'll wire up the console mockups and tooltip copy. Quick copy suggestion for tooltip: "Runtime settings control sampling and routing when this saved query is used to launch experiments. These settings can affect cost and metric comparability." 

marco: Thanks team. If no blockers, I'll add the audit event skeleton and coordinate with infra on the migration window.

devon: small follow-up: do we need RBAC for who can attach runtime_config? prod-owner only?

anna: Yes — attach-only permission to a saved query: `saved_query.runtime_config.manage` — product will decide exact roles but default to route-admin + org-admin.

ops-bot: ticket-created: #PLAT-4127 "SavedQuery runtime_config: schema + migration + console UX" assigned to eng-platform, eng-ui, infra.

anna: Great. We'll sync tomorrow after initial patches. :rocket:
